result.summary: FAIL. Structure passes: '## Что нашли (проверено 2026-09-29)' L17 and '## Где искали' L367 present; every price/competitor/market-size fact has a link; region marks via section headings or inline; conclusion markers L421-474; source types tagged; KZ personal-data/biometrics law section 7 (L274-336) with links. FAIL reasons (opened links do not say what the file claims / material gap in the mandatory law section): (1) L192-195: the file says the Almaty akimat rents Target EYE 'за 922 413 747 ₸ ... Победитель — Cloud Solutions Limited', which reads as the contract price. factcheck.kz says 922 413 747 ₸ was the allocated (выделено) sum and the winner's final contract was 909 млн ₸. Fix: state both (planned 922 413 747 ₸; contract with Cloud Solutions Limited 909 млн ₸). Also the 2027 figure 307 758 620 ₸ is written as 307,7 млн; it rounds to 307,8. (2) L314-315: the file says AI law 230-VIII art. 18 requires risk management 'систем высокого риска'. Art. 18 p.1 puts the continuous risk-management duty, including the at-least-yearly risk update (subp. 4), on the owner/holder of any AI system, not only high-risk ones. Fix the scope. Also: first official publication was 18.11.2025 (Егемен Қазақстан / Казахстанская правда); 20.11.2025 is the reference-bank date. The in-force date 18.01.2026 is consistent with 18.11.2025. (3) Section 7 omits Law of 24.06.2026 No 326-VIII (published 25.06.2026). Its PD-law amendments (art. 1 p.37) are not among the exceptions in its art. 2, so they took effect 60 days after publication, about 24.08.2026, before the 2026-09-29 check. The mirror page cited (edition 14.07.2026) shows 'Примечание ИЗПИ ... предусматривается изменение Законом РК от 24.06.2026 № 326-VIII' directly on the quoted art. 8 p.4, art. 12 p.2 and art. 25 p.2. What 326-VIII adds that matters for camera video: art. 6 personal-data identifiers include 'изображение лица субъекта' and 'биометрический вектор лица субъекта' (a face in a frame is personal data even without recognition, which bears on the conclusion hypothesis at L452-453); new art. 10-1 requires notifying the authorised body before starting and stopping processing (small and medium operators exempt); new art. 25-1 classifies operators (small up to 10 000 unique subjects, medium 10 000-500 000, large 500 000+; restricted-access data raises the category one level); art. 12 p.2 is reworded to 'в базе и (или) цифровом объекте, которые находятся на территории РК' (localisation stays). Fix: add a 326-VIII bullet with link https://zakon.uchet.kz/rus/docs/Z2600000326 and note that the art. 94-V text quoted is the 14.07.2026 edition, before 326-VIII. Checked by me and confirmed: art. 7 p.12, art. 8 p.1 and art. 12 p.2 match the mirror text. Art. 25 p.2 subp.8 says 'в течение одного рабочего дня ... c момента обнаружения нарушения безопасности персональных данных уведомить уполномоченный орган', so the one-working-day deadline is confirmed and the hedge at L288-290 can be replaced with it. Minor fixes (not blocking on their own): (a) L19: the section 1 heading says 'продаются и в Казахстане', but the Vocord bullet (L52-53) says Kazakhstan is not mentioned, and no KZ sale is shown for Zool.ai or Axxon. Narrow the heading to the products actually shown on sale in KZ (Trassir/DSSL, Macroscop via splus.kz, Ivideon). (b) L142-146: the 'Итог поиска' bullet has no market mark although it spans СНГ, мир and Казахстан sellers. The sentence 'Близкие продукты с публичной ценой есть только в ритейле (Veesion)' is a synthesis. Add the market marks and keep the bullet a plain search record ('not found at X, Y, Z'), or move the synthesis inside the conclusion markers. (c) L340: '(оценки аналитиков сильно расходятся; методики разные)': the claim that the methodologies differ has no source. Remove it or cite it, e.g. keep only the side-by-side numbers. (d) L264-272: the [компания] bullet has no source-type tag. Mark profit.kz and 2gis as directory/aggregator and [компания]group.kz as [вендор]. (e) L77-80: on manggis.kz, Hikvision DS-2CD4A26FWD-IZS/P at 279 000 ₸ is marked 'Товара нет в наличии', and DS-2XS6A46G1/P-IZS/C36S80 is titled only 'Сетевая камера 4МП', with no ANPR in the name. The conclusion at L448 uses 279 000 ₸ as the lower bound. Note the out-of-stock status or use an in-stock item. (f) adilet.zan.kz returned HTTP 200 for me, but only a JavaScript app shell with no act text. The SSL error was not reproduced; using the mirror remains justified. Confirmed as claimed: trassir.ru (≈310/495/670 тыс ₽, prices as of May 2022; accuracy 95-99 % plates, 90-94 % faces); manggis.kz (306 000 / 377 700 / 279 000 / 1 341 400 ₸); getsafeandsound avigilon-cost (≈$292/camera ACC7/Unity, Alta $179/yr, $35-60k for 25 cameras, $150-250k for 100, $700-1 500 install, updated 12.06.2026, authorized dealer); nbcboston (couple hundred dollars a month, 500 US stores, 20.03.2024); glazok.kz (22 000 ₸/camera/month, 10-day archive, СКУД/шлагбаум); mordorintelligence ($12.39B 2025 → $33.74B 2030, CAGR 22.18 %, 62/67/28 %, edge 26.3 %, North America 38 %); AI law art. 17 p.3 subp.5-6 verbatim. Not opened: section 5 (build it yourself); fetches were blocked by tool-permission classifier errors during the first run.
